Name: Cracks

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the secondary noise that roughens the surface inside the crack pattern.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Changes the small-scale variation inside the cracks without moving the crack network.
Params.Tooltip: Use this to vary crack surface texture independently.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Distorts the crack-surface detail field without changing the main crack geometry.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to break up repeated interior patterns.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in the crack interior detail.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; the main crack Voronoi layout is separate.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: CrackShapeDistortion
Params.Description: Controls the crack shape distortion value used by the Cracks base shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust crack shape distortion to change the generated terrain.

Params.Name: Smoothness
Params.Description: Controls how softly the shape transitions between regions.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values produce softer, less abrupt transitions.

Params.Name: CrackWidth
Params.Label: Crack Width
Params.Tooltip: Adjust crack width to change the generated terrain.
Params.Description: Controls the crack width value used by the Cracks base shape.

Params.Name: RandomHeights
Params.Description: Controls the random heights value used by the Cracks base shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust random heights to change the generated terrain.

Params.Name: NoiseStrength
Params.Description: Controls the amplitude of the added noise detail.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for stronger noise variation.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Description: Sets the size of the secondary noise added inside the crack pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values pack more crack-surface detail into the same pattern.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: SquareValue
Params.Label: Square Value
Params.Description: Squares the sampled value to change the shape's value profile.
Params.Tooltip: Enable to bias values toward zero and sharpen the response.

Params.Name: AbsoluteValue
Params.Label: Absolute Value
Params.Description: Reflects negative values into the positive range.
Params.Tooltip: Enable to remove negative valleys from the generated result.

Params.Name: MinMaxHeight
Params.Description: Controls the lower and upper height range used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the two components to set the shape's height interval.

Description: Generates a cracks-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
